name: 罗纹修身长袖打底上衣款
description: 细罗纹贴身不紧绷、圆领长袖、一套多穿的都市打底上衣

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool studio white #FFFFFF for the opening packshot, matte cement-grey #BFBDB8 and slate #3E4247 editorial fields for benefit and macro screens, one shallow-focus street stone #A9A49C field for the lifestyle screen; flat low-contrast surfaces only, no gradient, no storefront lettering
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft daylight-balanced 5600K key from the front-left with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle falloff, low contrast, soft contact shadow only, no harsh specular on the knit
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cement-grey studio board #BFBDB8, cool plaster wall #EDEBE8, off-white flat-lay field #F2F0EC, and the fine vertical rib of the knit itself as the macro surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for optional single-line labels only; every wording slot is left as an empty rail, no rendered copy inside the images
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in accent #B0483F, maximum two per screen, otherwise none
styleLock.presentationRules: faceless torso framing cropped above the collarbone or below the jaw, one consistent slight 3/4 body read for the garment, garment always worn or laid flat with contact shadow, stable scale across the whole set
noDrift: no identifiable model face or personal styling
no rendered brand marks or storefront signage
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent urban editorial womenswear basics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool studio white #FFFFFF, matte cement-grey #BFBDB8, deep slate #3E4247 and one brick-red accent #B0483F; cool daylight-balanced 5600K light with a soft front-left key, fill card, low contrast and soft contact shadows only; flat low-contrast backdrop fields with no gradients and no signage; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of the frame with every wording slot left as an empty rail; thin single-weight line icons in the accent only where a proof rail appears; faceless torso framing cropped above the collarbone or below the jaw, garment worn or laid flat with a visible contact shadow, stable scale and stable slight 3/4 body read; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no identifiable model identity.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼给出贴身廓形与罗纹质感，拿下点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, faceless torso cropped above the collarbone, shoulder to hem fully in frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key at 5600K with fill card, soft contact shadow under the hem
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product} worn on a faceless model torso cropped just above the collarbone. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with the body turned a few degrees off centre, shoulder to hem fully inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key at 5600K with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow where the hem meets the backdrop. Seamless cool studio white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with a clean even margin and no extra whitespace. Negative: no visible face, no identifiable model, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no printed label text, no cut-off sleeve or hem, no gradient backdrop.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清罗纹拉伸后回弹贴身这一核心卖点。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at chest height, jaw-to-hip crop, one hand stretching the sleeve width
shots.lighting: soft directional daylight key from the left at 5600K, low contrast, shadow falling to the right
shots.props: the model's own hand only, no objects
shots.whitespace: generous clean space on the right third, kept empty
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} worn on a faceless model cropped from jaw to hip. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle at chest height, one hand gently stretching the sleeve width so the vertical rib field opens and springs back. Soft directional daylight key from the left at 5600K, low contrast, shadow falling to the right, no hot spots on the yarn. Matte cement-grey studio board #BFBDB8 as the only backdrop. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous clean space on the right third kept empty and free of copy. Negative: no fabricated performance numbers, no measurement lines with digits, no face, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra props, no glossy plastic sheen on the knit.

shots.intent: 放大普通长袖穿久鼓包透薄的日常烦恼，引出本品。
shots.camera: matched split screen shot straight-on at eye level with identical crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat unflattering light, right panel the same 5600K soft key from the left, identical exposure
shots.background: neutral board #D9D6D1 identical on both panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels photographed straight-on at eye level with identical framing, identical crop and identical light. Left panel: an unbranded ordinary long-sleeve knit at the elbow, baggy, thinned and pilling, under flat unflattering light. Right panel: {product} on a faceless model showing a clean recovered sleeve line under the same soft key. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Neutral board background #D9D6D1 on both panels, daylight-balanced 5600K light from the left. Each panel carries its sleeve at 50-60% of that panel with no extra whitespace between the two halves. Negative: no real competitor identity, no brand marks, no numbers or percentage claims, no wording, no faces, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated garment parts.

shots.intent: 把上衣放进真实通勤出街场景，让买家自我代入。
shots.camera: low angle from hip height looking slightly upward, waist-to-thigh crop, candid street framing
shots.lighting: soft open-shade daylight at 5600K with a faint warm bounce from the stone behind, gentle shadow under the shoulder line
shots.background: shallow-focus weathered stone facade and pavement in #A9A49C
shots.props: a plain unprinted takeaway cup and a shoulder bag, never covering the garment
shots.whitespace: breathing room above the shoulder line, no copy zone
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a faceless model mid-stride on a city pavement outside a cafe front, awning and chairs dissolving into shallow focus behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle at hip height looking slightly upward so the torso line reads long, cropped from neck to thigh. Soft open-shade daylight at 5600K with a faint warm bounce from the stone behind, gentle shadow under the shoulder line, no harsh specular. Weathered stone and pavement backdrop in #A9A49C. Props: a plain unprinted takeaway cup and a shoulder bag, never covering the garment. The outfit occupies 40-50% of the frame with breathing room above the shoulder line. Negative: no recognisable face, no readable signage or storefront lettering, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, deformed hands avoided, no floating garment without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 用针脚与罗纹微距证明面料做工与弹性来源。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, camera straight-on and parallel to the fabric plane, tight zoom on the rib field
shots.lighting: soft skimming light sweeping from the upper right at 5600K, low fill to keep the rib valleys readable
shots.background: deep slate surface #3E4247 filling the frame
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on a hand-width of the vertical rib field where sleeve meets shoulder seam. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera straight-on and parallel to the fabric plane at macro distance, shallow depth of field with the nearest ribs razor sharp and the seam line readable. Soft skimming light sweeping in from the upper right at 5600K to open the rib valleys, one low fill so no highlight blows out. Deep slate surface #3E4247 fills the background. The texture detail fills 55-60% of the frame with no deliberate whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking fibre, no over-smoothed skin where a hand enters, no loose threads rendered as noise, no woven brand label, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 展示后背整片无接缝与加长袖口，打消版型疑虑。
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, nape-to-hip medium-close framing with head out of frame
shots.lighting: soft 5600K key from camera left plus a light rim from the right separating knit from wall
shots.background: cool plaster wall #EDEBE8 with a shallow-focus street edge
shots.whitespace: none, wall reads as clean negative field
shots.promptTemplate: Detail screen of {product} worn by a faceless model seen from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, showing the plain one-piece back yoke, the set-in shoulder seam and the long sleeve running past the wrist. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Medium-close framing from nape to hip with the head entirely outside the frame. Soft daylight key from camera left at 5600K plus a light rim from the right separating the knit from the wall, gentle shadow along the seam lines. Cool plaster wall #EDEBE8 as backdrop with a shallow-focus street edge. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no visible face or hair detail identifying a person, no stitched brand patch, no watermark, no fake logo, no text, no mirrored duplicate arms, no warped seam lines.

shots.intent: 同一件上衣两种穿法并列，讲清百搭值回价格。
shots.camera: two matched panels photographed straight-on at identical eye-level height and identical crop
shots.lighting: even soft key from the left at 5600K with matching contact shadows on both panels
shots.background: neutral grey panel #D3D0CB identical on both sides
shots.props: plain unprinted waistband only, no logo hardware
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce styling comparison, two matched panels photographed straight-on at identical eye-level height, identical crop and identical light so only the styling state differs. Left panel: {product} tucked into a plain high waistband for a clean waist line. Right panel: the same {product} released over the waistband for a straight untucked hem. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Faceless torsos cropped from collarbone to hip on both panels. Even soft key light from the left at 5600K, matching contact shadows, no relighting between panels. Neutral grey panel background #D3D0CB identical on both sides. Each panel holds the garment at 50-60% with no extra whitespace. Negative: no body-shape judgement, no fabricated slimming claim, no arrows or wording, no numbers, no faces, no watermark, no fake logo, no lighting mismatch between the two panels.

shots.intent: 平铺出同一件上衣的多种下装搭配，让用户做选择。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting from above at 5600K, crisp soft edges, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: three alternate bottoms and one folded outer layer, blank unprinted tags with no wording
shots.whitespace: even margins around the grid, no copy zone
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce styling variant grid, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: {product} laid flat at the centre with three alternate bottoms and one folded outer layer arranged beside it as separate looks. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting from above at 5600K, crisp soft edges, no dramatic shadow and no warped straight lines. Cool off-white flat-lay field #F2F0EC under the whole layout. The garment group occupies 35-40% overall with even margins around the grid. Props: blank unprinted hang tags with no wording, one denim leg panel, one cargo skirt panel. Negative: no invented colourways, no duplicate garment parts, no readable label text, no scattered clutter, no perspective tilt on the flat pieces, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用留空参数栏与空印章框承接售后信任，不编造资质。
shots.camera: clean slight 3/4 body angle at chest height, jaw-to-knee crop
shots.lighting: soft even studio light from the front-left at 5600K with fill card, low contrast, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one blank proof rail and one empty seal outline in the lower third, no wording inside
shots.whitespace: clean margin along the left edge holding the empty rails
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust close for {product} worn on a faceless model at a clean slight 3/4 body angle, cropped from jaw to knee with the hands relaxed and out of the way. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft even studio light from the front-left at 5600K with a fill card, low contrast, soft contact shadow grounding the figure. Matte concrete panel #C6C3BD behind. A blank unprinted proof rail and an empty seal outline sit in the lower third as placeholders with no digits, no certificates and no wording rendered inside them, and clean margin kept along the left edge. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, sales counts, lab results or fabric percentages; no fake badges, no readable text in the empty frames, no watermark, no fake logo, no visible face.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 近白棚拍正身半裸脸裁切、手轻拉手肘处袖管显罗纹；002 石质建筑前正面穿搭，喇叭形加长袖口与高腰腰带；003 咖啡座红色雨棚虚化街拍、卡其工装短裙、手持手机；004 白灰泥墙前坐姿、白色褶皱短裙与单肩包；005 街头背身 45 度、后背整片无印花；006 正面中景、格纹衬衫系腰与外带杯。六张为同一件黑色上衣的不同搭配与机位，不是同构图仅换色的色卡陈列，故未触发变体闸门，按常规转化分镜拆。品类判定以图为准：贴身针织长袖上衣，归「女装/上衣」，非外套也非内衣。已剥离：源品牌字标与一切店铺字样、模特面容与身份特征（全部改写为无身份躯干裁切）、雨棚与门头可读字样、外带杯与吊牌上的印刷文字、任何评分徽章与平台角标；所有卖点/参数位置改为空白栏位与留空指示条，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
